text:
erin: quick check — webinar in 4 days. paid target 450 regs, daily cap $2k. weekend pacing low; want a fast execution: creative swap + tightened daypart + 10% retarget holdback.

gabe: agree. weekend traffic lighter but higher noise. quick plan: 1) swap to UI-heavy hero for search; 2) speaker-led for retarget; 3) daypart boost 11:00-17:00 local; 4) negative keywords: free, sample, pdf, torrent.

marta: will push 4 creatives (UI / speaker / benchmark stat / customer quote). CTAs: "Register" vs "Save my seat". We'll label variant IDs as A_UI, B_SPK, C_BM, D_CUST.

ads-bot: yesterday: spend $1.6k, paid regs 28, paid CPA $57, search CPA $39, retarget CPA $84, landing conv 2.7% :bar_chart:

ryan: critical — add 10% holdback on retarget seed to measure incrementality. route paid leads to tag webinar_paid_apr and run 2-day nurture sequence (confirm + reminder).

erin: tracking note — a recent landing variant had missing event for "register_complete" on 2 creatives. Marta hold those variant IDs until dev confirms GTM event.

marta: ack. pausing B_SPK until GTM fix. uploading creative sheet now with UTMs.

paul: pseudo bid rules to implement in SA360 / manager:
```
if recency_days <= 5 and page_depth >=2:
  bid_mult = 1.4
elif recency_days <= 14:
  bid_mult = 1.1
else:
  bid_mult = 0.6
```
Also cap non-brand CPC = $10, brand = $30.

ops: CRM mapping confirmed. will include creative_id and keyword in webhook payload. set suppression for existing customers.

gabe: quick UTM to standardize:
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=webinar_apr&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={variant_id}

ads-bot: note if holdback enabled expect immediate drop of ~9% in paid regs but cleaner lift signal.

erin: timeline — today: upload creatives + neg keywords + implement bid rules + holdback. tomorrow AM: creative swap at 9:00 and start 5-day measurement window. owners: Marta (creatives & GTM), Paul (bid rules), Ops (CRM), Ryan (holdback & measurement), Erin (lead).

marta: will monitor bounce by variant; will pause any variant exceeding 55% bounce within first 3 hours.

erin: ok setting 1pm PT sync to confirm everything. thumbs up if you can make it.
